description_expanded:
In Cypress Dunes, a Topsail community

1.2 miles from Beach Highlands Beach Access

Close to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park!

4 bedrooms, 4 baths

Elevator

Clubhouse: outdoor fireplace, large infinity-edge pool, large jetted hot tub!

Community pools (heated seasonally)

4 bikes

Gas grill

Great restaurants

Fun shops

Sun's Up Fun's Up by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Sun's Up Fun's Up—a stunning 3,300 sq ft home in the exclusive Cypress Dunes community, where privacy and luxury go hand in hand. This place is all about the views of the Gulf and the untouched beauty of Topsail Hill State Park. Plus, you’re just a few steps away from the amazing Beach Club. Dive into the infinity pool, soak in the oversized hot tub, or work out in the full fitness center. And don’t miss those epic sunrises and sunsets from the expansive decks! This 3-story home is packed with space and comfort. On the first floor, you’ll find a cozy built-in bunk room with a queen bed, right across from the oversized laundry room and a full bathroom. Head up to the second floor, where three bedrooms each come with their own private bathroom.

The primary bedroom even has a killer view of Topsail Hill State Park. The third floor is where the magic happens—there’s a spacious kitchen and dining area, plus a living area with a fireplace and large windows that show off jaw-dropping views of the Gulf and the park’s white sandy dunes. With 4 bedrooms, 4 baths, and even an elevator, Sun's Up Fun's Up is the ultimate spot for your next beach getaway! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 1.2 miles from the beach (Beach Highlands Access) - 4 bedrooms, 4 baths - 3304 sq ft - Gas grill - Elevator - Community pools - 6 wristbands provided for pool use - 4 bikes included Overnight: - 2 queens in 1st floor bunk room; shared bath - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV (50") - 2 twins in 2nd floor guest room; private bath - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; private bath: TV (32") Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
